comment: The images the gate builds for checks that need one, the checks it runs on them, and the affected checks it may skip. A check that is affected by a change, is not pure-host, needs no board and is in none of the lists makes the gate refuse (tools/integration-gate.py). "images" are CMake recipes built once per tree state; the variants of the gate (VARIANTS) are named directly. {elf:X} and {build:X} are an image's ELF and build directory, {output} a new evidence directory. {session:X} is the session bytes tools/gate_session.py builds for image X; {bundle:X} the probe ELF that apps/board-bundles-power/build-opp.py builds for the bundle X ("bundles" lists its arguments).

ret-npu-load.uses: the CPU-return NPU image of apps/cpu-npu-concurrency (apps/cpu-npu-concurrency/README.md)

ret-gpu.uses: the CPU-return GPU image of apps/gpu-lifecycle (apps/gpu-lifecycle/README.md)

storage-read.uses: the supervised SD0 read image (apps/storage-read); the host session is modeled by checks/storage-read-fixture.py (tools/gate_session.py), at profile 2, or the profile in the image name (storage-read-p1: profile 1)

storage-read-p1.uses: the supervised SD0 read image (apps/storage-read); the host session is modeled by checks/storage-read-fixture.py (tools/gate_session.py), at profile 2, or the profile in the image name (storage-read-p1: profile 1)
